verdict.rationale: The evidence covers adjacent features: workflows that apply policy logic to transactions, Source Workflow evaluations returned on events, a services object showing vendor execution status, and marketing claims about real-time risk signals. None of it documents configuring customer risk factors in a risk-scoring model, or any view that explains why a customer's risk score changed. Adjacent workflow and monitoring capabilities do not transfer to this story.

support.subject: As a compliance-officer, I can configure customer risk factors and inspect why the risk score changed
